name: Bing
build_route_note: Mike's Bing Places agency account, GBP sync. The agency account imports each client from their Google Business Profile and re-syncs with the Sync button. Fix Bing NAP by fixing GBP first, then press Sync. A sync publishes in 7-12 days ('Pending publish') with no phone verification. Never create a per-client Microsoft account or a listings@ Bing account. On 2026-10-21 the agency account held 4 locations (SCC, NM and two others). If an agent ever needs to log in, Mike adds a user on the agency account and shares the item in Vaultwarden. Until then, Bing work is a one-click Mike task. Source: Bing row of references/directory-verification.md in the client-citation-building skill.
